traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Penthoraceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins serrate; veins pinnate; blades lanceolate; stipules absent; plants hermaphrodite; ovary half inferior; floral cup present; stems herbaceous; flowers in cymes; flowers actinomorphic; perianth usually tepals, sometimes sepals and petals; fruit follicle; parts of each whorl 5 (-8); stamens 10; carpels (4-) 5 (-8). Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
